title: Access National Parks annual pass discounts when you renew your rego
summary: Eligible customers can receive discounts on certain National Parks annual passes when they renew their vehicle registration online.
intro:
Discounts on certain National Parks annual passes are offered to eligible customers when they renew their registration online.

The discounts apply to the:

Your vehicle must be a passenger vehicle with 8 seats or less, and only used for non-commercial purposes.

If you're eligible and would like to take advantage of the savings offered, you'll be able to select 'Buy a pass' on the final screen of the registration renewal process.
who_can_apply: Your vehicle must be a passenger vehicle with 8 seats or less.
The vehicle must only be used for non-commercial purposes.
what_you_need: Select 'Buy a pass' on the final screen of the registration renewal process.
The registration renewal process can be found at https://www.service.nsw.gov.au/transaction/renew-a-vehicle-registration.
